note: Proof runs on the author's machine, 2026-11-02. Whisper ran on the CPU (int8): this box's CTranslate2 is built for CUDA 12 and its venv carries CUDA 13, so it can't use the card here and no VRAM was used.

captions.title: A voice-over on a silent clip
captions.alt: A cardboard robot in a beret sits in a director's chair beside a toy film camera. White captions with a black edge read: This little robot directs every shot.
captions.heard: This little robot directs every shot. Whisper wrote these words down, and FFM peg drew them in a real font.
captions.measured: Whisper's words were compared with the script by a program, and each caption card was read back off the burned frames by Tesseract OCR. The audio track was checked byte for byte against the source. Nobody has listened to it.
